prompt: when did christmas day fall on easter monday
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] correctly answers that Christmas Day on Dec 25 cannot coincide with Easter Monday, since Easter Monday always falls between March 22 and April 25. Candidates [2], [3], and [4] all give specific (and incorrect) date/overlap claims without any valid basis, contradicting the fixed date range of Easter. Therefore [1] is the only correct and complete response; the others are decisively false.
